description: IdentityProvider is polymorphic on `type`; the converted model keeps only the base `type`, so S.Struct strips the EntraIdentityProvider `properties.principalType` payload and ARM rejects the user PUT. Add the EntraIdentityProvider subtype member to the base shape.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The principal type of the user: `user` or `servicePrincipal`.
MicrosoftEntraID: the Entra identity properties for the user.
